verdict.rationale: Hands-on probe confirms Gitleaks supports `--report-format json` producing a findings.json report usable for CI gating (exit code 1) and baseline diffing, directly satisfying the JSON requirement. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents SARIF output support, so the SARIF half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/probe of SARIF report-format, and confirmation of other formats (csv/junit) for downstream tooling.
